description: A factory has two machines, A and B. Each day, machine A can make 30 items and consumes 100 kWh. Machine B can make 50 items and consumes 120 kWh per day. The factory must produce at least 1000 items per day and has 3000 kWh of electricity available per day. Since there are not many workers that can operate both machines, at most 30% of the machines must be of type B. Further, at least 5 machines of type A should be used. How many of each machine should be used to minimize the total number of machines?

ProductionA.definition: Production rate of Machine A in items per day

ProductionB.definition: Production rate of Machine B in items per day

EnergyA.definition: Energy consumption of Machine A in kWh per day

EnergyB.definition: Energy consumption of Machine B in kWh per day

MinProduction.definition: Minimum required production in items per day

MaxEnergy.definition: Maximum available energy in kWh per day

MaxPercentB.definition: Maximum percentage of machines that can be of type B

MinA.definition: Minimum number of machines of type A

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of machines used (the sum of machines of type A and type B)"

constraints.description: 30 * (number of machines of type A) + 50 * (number of machines of type B) must be at least 1000
100 * (number of machines of type A) + 120 * (number of machines of type B) must be at most 3000
(number of machines of type B) must be less than or equal to 0.3 * (total number of machines)
Number of machines of type A must be at least 5
Number of machines of type B must be non-negative

numA.definition: Number of machines of type A used per day

numB.definition: Number of machines of type B used per day
